name: @diplatonib/opencode-remote-config
description: Opencode plugin for loading remote organization config from HTTP server

scripts.build:
rm -rfv ./out/ && mkdir -p ./out && echo "/**

$(cat README.md)

*/" > ./out/remote-config.js && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --tree-shaking=true --target=esnext --format=esm --platform=node >> ./out/remote-config.js
